phase7_ndwi_alignment_issue: The original Phase 7 NDWI agreement output files were written with the 10m NDWI raster profile although their comparison arrays were 20m. Their prior counts were computed from 20m arrays, but those raster files are mis-georeferenced/resized in the output grid. Phase 7 outputs were not overwritten. This Phase 7B rebuild writes all NDWI and MNDWI comparisons on the exact selected-pair 20m native B11/MNDWI grid.
limitations: Cross-sensor agreement remains corroboration only; optical indices and model predictions are not reference truth.
S1/S2 acquisition dates are non-coincident; exact offsets are listed per comparison.
No fused confirmed flood map or impact area is produced.
